title: Upside Living Villas by Versace Home
meta_description: In collaboration with Versace Home, Dar Al Arkan offers exclusive villas with innovative interiors, blending luxury with functionality.
description:
In collaboration with Versace Home, Dar Al Arkan offers exclusive villas with innovative interiors, blending luxury with functionality.

Situated within the Shams Ar Riyadh development, these villas provide residents with a prestigious address and access to premium amenities.

Each villa is designed with meticulous attention to detail, reflecting the elegance and sophistication associated with the Versace brand.

Upside Living Concept Only 12 villas, each an architectural masterpiece emanating Versace living inside and out, located in the heart of the most premium communities in Riyadh, Shams Ar Riyadh. The Versace Villas completely disrupt the conventional way of living. Each villa has its hosting area on the first floor and its family area on the ground floor, with both floors connected by a cascading waterfall. The villas have smart home automation, and every floor-to-ceiling window uncovers panoramic views of Wadi Hanifa. This is the Upside Living concept, an exclusive lifestyle only for the elite.

The villas sit on the vibrant King Khalid Road in Shams Ar Riyadh, the ideal location for easy access to the capital's prime lifestyle destinations, renowned educational institutions, and top attractions.

Spanning 5 million square meters, Shams Ar Riyadh is a unique 'city-within-a-city' and the first of its kind in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Equipped with world-class amenities, a grand mosque, a luxury mall, and a chic promenade, Shams Ar Riyadh is truly a modern and sophisticated community that raises the benchmark for luxury living in the capital.

Shams Al Arous, spanning approximately 863,000 square meters, is a meticulously planned integrated community featuring residential and mixed-use buildings, schools, commercial centers, green spaces, government offices, and mosques.

Situated in one of Jeddah's most significant areas, Shams Al Arous offers residents a peaceful and modern living environment with convenient access to the city's main roads.

The development includes a variety of housing options, educational institutions, retail spaces, and recreational areas, catering to diverse lifestyle needs.

AN INTEGRATED COMMUNITY PROJECT Covering approximately 863,000 square meters, Shams Al Arous is a well-planned, best-in-class integrated community, in one of the most substantial areas in Jeddah, Riyadh. It features an array of residential and mixed-use buildings, in addition to schools, commercial centers, beautifully landscaped green spaces, government offices, and mosques. Shams Al Arous offers residents a peaceful and ideal modern living environment.

Shams Al Arous is located to the east of Jeddah, about 5 kilometers from the intersection of Palestine Road and Al-Haramain Road. This location is directly connected with the city's main roads, linked by Haramain Road/Palestine Road in the north and King Abdullah Road in the south.

The project comprises a diverse range of residential and mixed-use buildings. The residential areas of the project are characterized by contemporary designs, both diverse and harmonious, with multiple areas of apartments and villas.

The infrastructure of the project is ideal, as it includes a major road network with an extension to Palestine Road, internal roads and sidewalks, electrical power and water supply networks, a drainage system, street lighting, and landscaping.

title: Parisiana
meta_description: Parisiana represents a strategic real estate asset in Riyadh's rapidly expanding downtown. Its central location ensures consistent demand, high-value appreciation, and long-term investment stability.
description:
Parisiana represents a strategic real estate asset in Riyadh's rapidly expanding downtown. Its central location ensures consistent demand, high-value appreciation, and long-term investment stability.

Land in a prime central location, supporting mixed-use urban development

High demand for commercial and residential real estate in downtown Riyadh

A well-integrated urban district attracting businesses and residents alike

OVERVIEW Parisiana is comprised of 2,797 apartments, 254 villas, and about 25,000 square meters of office spaces, all overlooking the main streets of the project. Additionally, it contains 63,000 square meters of retail space on Parisiana Boulevard. Strategically located in the Al Suwaidi district, bordering Wadi Hanifa and King Fahd Road to the east, Parisiana enjoys access to Riyadh's prime lifestyle destinations, such as Qasr Mall. The project also includes government offices, administrative buildings, a public park, schools, and mosques.

Commercial Housing: 43 Buildings with 1,318 residential apartments and floors dedicated to commercial area Residential Buildings: 87 Buildings with 1,479 residential apartments Residential Villas: 254 Villas Administrative Office Building: A total area of 25,000 sqm Mosques: Six mosques Schools: Four schools Shopping Centers: Parisiana Boulevard and Qasr Mall

Dar Al Arkan developed Al Suwaidi Park in the heart of the Parisiana Riyadh project, on an area of approximately 155,000 square meters. The park has two segments; the Family Park, occupying about 60% of the area, and the Youth Park, occupying 30% of Al Suwaidi Park. The Family Park is located at a higher level and includes amenities such as restaurants, a pool area, a beautiful fountain that breaks into water tables, walkways, a Masjid, and parking lots for about 150 cars.

Al Qasr Mall OVERVIEW Qasr Mall is located to the south of downtown Riyadh, just off King Fahd road. It was inaugurated in 2013, and soon became a major lifestyle and shopping destination in the capital. A family destination by choice, Qasr Mall often hosts various entertainment and awareness programs coupled with exciting giveaways. THE MALL Qasr Mall has advanced design architecture and facilities, on par with international standards. The total area of the building is about 250,000 square meters, while the leasing area is 85,000 square meters. It consists of four floors with more than 350 retail stores and a parking capacity for 1,846 cars, as well as 35,000 square meters of spacious interiors. ACCOLADES Qasr Mall received 'The Best Commercial Project' award in 2013 for its strategic location, iconic brands selection, and exterior design, deemed the largest advertising interface and state-of-the-art building management systems from Schneider International. Visit Qasr Mall website at: www.qasrmall.com
